title: Lesson 2 Quiz: A Brief History That Explains Today

questions.text: Which statement best describes the evolution from early rule-based AI to modern generative AI?
options: Rule-based systems used neural networks to learn patterns from data.
Early AI relied on explicit if-then rules, while modern generative AI creates new content from learned patterns.
Generative AI requires manual coding for each possible scenario.
Machine learning removed the need for any data input.
questions.explanation: Early rule-based systems depended on explicit programming for every scenario, whereas modern generative AI learns patterns and can generate new content.

questions.text: Traditional machine learning allows computers to spot patterns in data without explicit programming for each rule.
questions.explanation: In traditional machine learning, algorithms learn patterns from data, eliminating the need for manually coding each rule.
